text_simplified: At this stage, the child needs opportunities to play with others to learn sharing and self-control. Parents can help by engaging in role-exchange games and expanding his sentences. Tantrums should also be handled with understanding, calming him when he feels frustrated. Music and dance are beloved activities for a child at this age.

review_defects.why: In this parenting context, 'ألعاب تبادل الأدوار' refers to turn-taking games where children alternate turns, not games where roles are exchanged or pretended. The literal translation 'role-exchange games' changes the intended meaning and may confuse readers.
